timeline.body:
Similar to the _search API, ESQL should support the preference parameter.

Closes #106273

timeline.diff_hunk:
@@ -570,7 +572,7 @@ void lookupDataNodes(
                 SearchRequest.DEFAULT_INDICES_OPTIONS,
                 filter,
                 null,
-                null,
+                preference,

timeline.body: The motivation of this PR is to address this test failure. By using a preference, we can ensure that we execute against the same sets of data nodes in that test.
